verdict.rationale: Sketch documents its own plugin system: plugins written in JavaScript, installed by placing them in the Plugins folder, and published via skpm. Community users describe a 'robust plugin ecosystem' and a 'massive collection of plugins', which supports the large-community part of the story. Missing for 10: evidence of an official, browsable plugin marketplace or directory, any evidence of the named plugin categories (icons, data fillers, accessibility checkers), and current independent corroboration of the ecosystem's size.

support.subject: As a designer, I can extend the editor from a large plugin community or marketplace — icons, data fillers, accessibility checkers, and more

citations.quote: you can install plugins by simply moving them into the Plugins folder yourself.
Use the Sketch Plugin Manager `skpm` to publish a new plugin or an update of an existing one.
Sketch has a massive collection of plugins that forms a large part of its appeal.
